title: WHAT I HAVE DISCOVERED ABOUT MYSELF

questions.prompt: My greatest discovery: What have I learned about myself during this week that I did not fully recognise before?
My strengths: What positive qualities do I possess, and how can I use them more effectively?
My areas for improvement: Which attitudes or behaviours have I recognised as needing change?
My understanding of responsibility: What have I learned about taking ownership of my actions?
My relationship with others: How can I become easier to communicate and work with?
My professional growth: Which Zura Spa standards do I need to practise more consistently?
My commitment: What three specific changes will I begin practising from today?
Which of these lessons challenged me most? Which one revealed something about myself that I had previously overlooked?
What am I ready to leave behind? What attitudes, responses, habits, or ways of thinking no longer represent the person I want to become?
What am I ready to build? What qualities, relationships, disciplines, and professional habits do I want to develop?

What will people experience differently about me? If my colleagues and management interacted with me after this transformation programme, what positive differences would they notice through my actions?
